source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the concepts in hypothesis testing (PDF 95-97).

blocks.text: Hypothesis testing durust faislon tak pohanchne ke liye chand kaleedi tasawwurat saath use karti hai: test statistics, critical region, significance level aur p-value.

Test statistic namoone ke data se nikla number hai jo batata hai ke nataij H0 ki tawaqqo se kitne door hain. Mukhtalif tests mukhtalif statistics use karte hain, maslan t-value, chi-square value aur F-value.

blocks.caption: Do test statistics
rows: x_bar: namoone ka mean; mu_0: H0 ke tehat population mean; s: namoone ka standard deviation; n: namoone ka size
O_i: har category ki mushahida frequency; E_i: har category ki mutawaqqa frequency

blocks.text: 25 talaba ke namoone ka mean score 80 hai. Agar namoone ka standard deviation 10 ho to kya yeh population mean 75 se numayan mukhtalif hai? t = (80 - 75) / (10 / sqrt(25)) = 5 / (10 / 5) = 5 / 2 = 2.5. 24 degrees of freedom par alpha = 0.05 ki two-tailed critical value taqreeban 2.06 hai, is liye t = 2.5 critical region mein hai aur H0 radd hota hai: mean 75 se waqai mukhtalif hai.

Yun chi^2 = 3.4 hai. Ise chuni hui significance level (alpha = 0.05) aur degrees of freedom (6 rukh - 1 = 5) ke liye chi-square table ki critical value se milaya jata hai. Woh critical value 11.07 hai; kyunke 3.4 < 11.07, H0 (pansa munsif hai) radd nahi hota.

blocks.alt: 60 phenkon mein chhe rukhon ki mushahida frequencies (10, 12, 8, 14, 9 aur 7) ka bar chart, mutawaqqa 10 par dashed line. Dabba hal dikhata: 0 + 0.4 + 0.4 + 1.6 + 0.1 + 0.9 = 3.4; df = 5; alpha 0.05 par critical value = 11.07. Note: 3.4 < 11.07, is liye H0 (pansa munsif) radd nahi hota.
blocks.caption: Pansay ka chi-square test (pansay ki misal ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Munsif pansa bhi 60 phenkon mein har rukh bilkul 10 dafa nahi deta; test poochta hai ke kya farq us se bare hain jo ittifaq aam taur par paida karta hai.

blocks.text: Critical region, significance level aur p-value

items: Critical region: test statistic ki intehai qeematon ki had jin par H0 radd hota hai. Yeh testing se pehle tay hoti aur significance level par munhasir hai; graphs aksar ise dikhate hain.
Significance level (alpha): H0 ke sach hote hue use radd karne ka zyada se zyada khatra jo hum qabool karte hain; aam qeemat 0.05. Kam alpha ka matlab sakht test. Ise tajzie se pehle chuna jata hai.

p-value: H0 sach hone ki soorat mein mushahida nateeja, ya us se intehai nateeja, milne ka imkaan. Chhoti p-value H0 ke khilaf mazboot saboot hai, kyunke aisa nateeja ittifaqan kam hi hota. Agar p-value alpha se kam ho to H0 radd hota hai.

blocks.text: Maslan ustad jaanchta hai ke kya naya tareeqa-e-tadrees number behtar karta hai; H0 kehta hai koi asar nahi. Agar tajzie se p = 0.03 aaye to kyunke 0.03 < 0.05, H0 radd hota hai: shumariyati saboot hai ke tareeqe ne karkardagi behtar ki. Tib mein nayi dawa ka purani se muwazna karte hue 0.01 ki p-value mazboot saboot deti hai ke behtari sirf ittifaq nahi. p-values samajhna baghair munasib saboot ke hypothesis radd ya qabool karne se bachata hai.

blocks.alt: Ghante jaisi curve H0 sach hone par test statistic ki mutawaqqa qeematein dikhati. Dashed 'critical value' line se aage daen dum surkh: critical region, raqba alpha = 0.05. Purple line critical region ke andar test statistic, aur us se aage chhota purple raqba p-value hai. Note: test statistic critical region mein (p-value < alpha) to H0 radd; warna H0 radd nahi.
blocks.caption: Critical region aur p-value (7.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dono qawaid aik hi faisla hain: critical value se aage ke test statistic ki p-value hamesha alpha se kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Test alpha = 0.05 ke saath p = 0.08 deta hai. Faisla kya hai, aur kya yeh H0 ko sach sabit karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke 0.08, 0.05 se zyada hai, H0 radd nahi hota. Yeh H0 ko sach sabit nahi karta; sirf yeh ke data ne us ke khilaf kafi mazboot saboot nahi diya.

items: Test statistic: namoone se number, maslan t = (x_bar - mu_0) / (s / sqrt(n)), chi^2 = (O - E)^2 / E ka jama.
Critical region: qeematein jo H0 radd karwati hain; alpha (aksar 0.05) is ka size tay karta.
